lines.en: label utaspring7:
scene utakaraokekiss1
: Master...are you really sure you want to order all this? Because I know you’re obsessed with me and everything, but this seems excessive by even {i}your{/i} standards.
lines.zh: : 主人……你真的确定要点这么多吗？因为我知道你迷我迷得不行什么的，可这即便以{i}你的{/i}标准来看也太夸张了。

lines.en: : Money is naught but a renewable resource, Uta-chan. And it’s only a matter of time until my bank account is replenished.
lines.zh: : 钱财不过是可再生资源罢了，Uta 酱。而且我的银行账户迟早会补回来的。

lines.en: : I can’t believe you’re still mooching off the school like that.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你还在那样蹭学校的钱。

lines.en: : It feels like you’ve been on break longer than you were even a teacher at this point. And that this money would probably be better spent on educating girls like Miku who need it the most.
lines.zh: : 感觉你休假的时间都已经比你当老师的时间还长了。而且这笔钱大概花在 Miku 那样最需要它的女孩的教育上更有意义。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong here, but I remember you being right behind her in the grade rankings.
lines.zh: : 如果我记错了你尽管纠正我，不过我记得你在年级排名里就紧挨在她后面。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss2

: Your time away from the podium has clearly confused you. I am a smart girl who does and says smart things. Like how you should be more financially responsible than this, Master. I’m worried about you.
lines.zh: : 你离开讲台太久，显然已经糊涂了。我是个聪明的女孩，做的说的都是聪明事。比如你该比这更有财务责任心，主人。我很担心你。

lines.en: It’s a late night for me again.
lines.zh: 今晚我又熬夜了。

lines.en: {size=-2}Osako, who was the only other girl working tonight on account of Chika still being broken, left a short while ago. And without any other customers around and the cafe already being closed, it’s just Uta and me left now.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}Osako 是今晚唯一另一个上班的女孩，因为 Chika 还坏着，她刚才先走了。现在没有其他客人，咖啡厅也已经打烊，就剩下 Uta 和我。{/size}

lines.en: Which, if I were not a good man, would mean that she is mere minutes away from being bent over the table and violently fingered next to an omelet.
lines.zh: 如果我是个好人，这意味着再过几分钟她就要被按在桌上、在一盘蛋包饭旁边被粗暴地抠了。

lines.en: I have chosen not to desecrate this holy land, though. And am more than happy simply receiving unsolicited financial advice until she ultimately kicks me out.
lines.zh: 不过我选择不亵渎这片圣地。而且只要能一直收到这些不请自来的理财建议，直到她最终把我赶出去，我就已经很满足了。

lines.en: Which {i}probably{/i} should have happened by now, to be honest. But the two of us do have a history of staying up late together, so...I guess this is just more of that.
lines.zh: 说实话，那{i}大概{/i}早就该发生了。可我们俩本来就有一起熬夜的前科，所以……我想这也不过是又一次罢了。

lines.en: I would like to apologize to all of the starving children in Africa, though. There is no way I can eat all of this.
lines.zh: 不过我要向非洲所有挨饿的孩子道歉。这么多我是不可能吃得完的。

lines.en: : There’s no need to worry about me, Uta. Just accept the generous commission you’re earning off of my bill and put it toward your next Halloween costume.
lines.zh: : 不用担心我，Uta。就把从我账单上赚到的那份慷慨提成收下，存起来做你下一套万圣节服装吧。

lines.en: : And now you’re making up holidays to try and trick me into saying something dumb? How dare you, Master.
lines.zh: : 现在你还编出节日来，想骗我说点蠢话？你怎么敢，主人。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Halloween is gone.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。万圣节已经没了。

lines.en: : God, I hope the next reset fixes that. I’m not good with change. Especially when it’s just abruptly woven into a mostly unchanging timeloop.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我希望下一次重置能把它修好。我不擅长应对变化。尤其是当它被硬生生织进一个基本不变的时间循环里的时候。

lines.en: : And now you’re trying to convince me we’re caught in a timeloop? Try as you might, Master, I am still smarter than Miku and will not be deceived by such-
lines.zh: 现在你又想说服我们被困在时间循环里了？随你怎么试吧，主人，我还是比 Miku 聪明，不会被这——

lines.en: : Uta.
lines.zh: : Uta。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss3
: Hai.
: I think you’re special.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你很特别。

lines.en: : Of course you do. I am a being that transcends human cuteness and feeds off of your arousal. There are few things more special than that.
lines.zh: : 你当然会这么觉得。我是超越了人类可爱程度、靠你的性欲为生的存在。没多少东西比这更特别了。

lines.en: : No, I mean that you were supposed to stop me from talking about timeloops just now and you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 不，我的意思是你刚才本该阻止我谈时间循环的，可你没有。

lines.en: : I mean, I tried to. But you’re still talking about them for some reason when I’d really rather go back to talking about how cute you think I am instead.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我试着阻止了。可不知道为什么你还在谈那个，而我其实更想回去聊你觉得我有多可爱。

lines.en: You know, maybe I can just file this in my drawer of “weird shit to bring up at my next slumber party” and spend the rest of the night at least {i}trying{/i} to enjoy myself.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，也许我可以把这件事归档到“下次睡衣派对上拿出来讲的怪事”那个抽屉里，然后今晚剩下的时间至少{i}试着{/i}享受一下。

lines.en: It’s too late to drag someone new into the black hole of endless fuckery that is Kumon-mi. And it’s not like Uta doesn’t have enough weird shit of her own already going on already.
lines.zh: 现在再把什么新人拖进 Kumon-mi 这个无尽的乱交黑洞已经太晚了。而且 Uta 自己的怪事也已经够多了。

lines.en: I’ll just send Makoto a note or something and let her take care of it. She probably wants more busy work, despite what she’d tell you nowadays.
lines.zh: 我就给 Makoto 发个消息什么的，让她去处理好了。尽管她现在嘴上不承认，她大概还想要更多杂活。

lines.en: : Put that phone down when you’re talking to me. I want attention.
lines.zh: : 跟我说话的时候把手机放下。我要关注。

lines.en: : Sorry. I just need to send something to Makoto really quickly.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是要赶紧给 Makoto 发个东西。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss4
: It’s another {i}girl?!{/i} So brazen! Anyone but Makoto! She’ll just brag about it the next time I see her and it’s damn near impossible to stop that girl when she feels superior to somebody!
lines.zh: : 又是另一个{i}女孩{/i}？！这么明目张胆！谁都行就是别是 Makoto！下次我见到她她准会拿这事吹牛，而那女孩一旦觉得自己比别人优越，简直拦都拦不住！

lines.en: : Okay. Message sent. I will now go back to focusing entirely on Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 好了。消息发出去了。我现在要回去全身心专注在 Uta 酱身上了。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss5
: No. Uta-chan is done with you. You have overstayed your welcome and she kindly asks you to never come back here again.
lines.zh: : 不。Uta 酱跟你完了。你已经待得太久，她好心请你以后再也不要回来了。

lines.en: : Got it. In that case, I’ll just take the check and stop spending time with you altogether.
lines.zh: : 明白了。那样的话，我就结账走人，再也不跟你待在一起了。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss6
: Oh, please. We both know you can’t stay away from Uta-chan no matter how hard you try.
lines.zh: : 拜托。我们俩都知道，不管你怎么努力都躲不开 Uta 酱。

lines.en: : Which is great because something tells me Uta-chan would cry a lot if that ever happened. And not just because her income source would be getting essentially chopped in half.
lines.zh: 这很好，因为我有种感觉，要是真有那么一天，Uta 酱会哭得很厉害。而且不光是因为她的收入来源基本要被砍掉一半。

lines.en: : Well, I guess I shouldn’t be making her {i}cry.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我大概不该让她{i}哭{/i}。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss7
: No. In fact, you should do more things to make her happy. Like spending more time with her outside of maid cafes and exploring new tunnels and the like.
lines.zh: : 对。事实上，你应该多做些让她开心的事。比如在女仆咖啡厅之外多陪陪她，去探索新的隧道之类的。

lines.en: : I wasn’t aware there {i}were{/i} any more tunnels.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还{i}有{/i}别的隧道。

lines.en: : That’s funny. Because I can think of at least one that you should have explored a long time ago but {i}haven’t{/i} yet for some reason and now I have to keep exploring it all by myself.
lines.zh: : 真好笑。因为我至少能想到一条——你早就该去探索、却不知为什么一直{i}没去{/i}的，现在害得我只能一直自己去探索。

lines.en: : Are you...talking about masturbating right now?
lines.zh: : 你……现在是在说自慰吗？

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss8
: At {i}work?{/i} Of course not, Master. We both know that such conduct is strictly banned in this establishment.
lines.zh: : 在{i}上班{/i}的时候？当然不是，主人。我们都知道这种行为在本店是被严格禁止的。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss9
: That said, though...
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来……

lines.en: : Do you want to...
lines.zh: : 你想不想……

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss10
: Maybe...keep hanging out after this?
lines.zh: : 也许……待会儿继续一起玩？

lines.en: : And maybe...I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 还有也许……我不知道……

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss11
: Pick up where we left off that night I told you I love you?...
lines.zh: : 从我跟你说我爱你的那个晚上接上？……

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss12
: Huh...
: I actually said it...
lines.zh: : 我真的说出来了……

lines.en: : Can you close your eyes for a second while I walk to the bathroom?
lines.zh: : 你能不能闭一下眼睛，让我走到洗手间去？

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss13
: Is that...a no?
lines.zh: : 那是……不行吗？

lines.en: : It’s-
lines.zh: : 只是——

lines.en: : You know {i}I{/i} can...take care of that {i}for{/i} you, right? I’m not mean enough to make you go exploring by yourself.
lines.zh: : 你知道{i}我{/i}可以……{i}替{/i}你解决的，对吧？我还没狠心到让你自己去探索。

lines.en: : Jesus Christ, Uta. Slow down or you’re going to kill me.
lines.zh: : 我的天哪，Uta。慢一点，不然你要了我的命。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss14
: AAaaaAAAaaaaaahhhh!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

lines.en: : I’m sorry! I’ve suddenly completely forgotten what it means to be subtle and I understand that was probably a lot when like 95%% of our banter is infinite flirting that never leads to anything! Forgive me!
lines.zh: 对不起！我突然彻底忘了什么叫含蓄，我也明白在我们 95% 的打情骂俏都是永远不会有结果的无限调情的情况下，这可能太猛了！原谅我！

lines.en: : It’s fine. And you didn’t need to apologize, but of course I forgive you.
lines.zh: : 没事。而且你不需要道歉，不过我当然原谅你。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss15
: Good. Now, do {i}other{/i} things to me.
lines.zh: : 好。那么，对我做{i}别{/i}的事吧。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss14
: AAaaaAAAaaaaaahhhh!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

lines.en: : I can’t stop! My only settings are “tease” and “whore!” There is no in-between! All those years of sexting lonely older guys has forever tainted my ability to insinuate that I want to be touched!
lines.zh: 我停不下来！我只有“撩”和“婊”两个档！没有中间值！那么多年跟寂寞的老男人发色情短信，已经永久污染了我暗示自己想被碰的能力！

lines.en: : Okay. That’s it. We need to get out of here right now or I really {i}am{/i} going to defile sacred land.
lines.zh: : 好了。就这样。我们得马上离开这儿，不然我真的{i}要{/i}亵渎圣地了。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss15
: I agree! And I know {i}just{/i} the place.
lines.zh: : 我同意！而且我知道{i}正好{/i}有个地方。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss16
: Well...it’s definitely a {i}place,{/i} alright.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这确实是个“{i}地方{/i}”，没错。

lines.en: : I paid for ten hours.
lines.zh: : 我付了十个小时。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss17
: You have too much faith in me.
lines.zh: : 你对我太有信心了。

lines.en: : I have just the right amount of faith in you. And we have come during a time of night where there is only one person working and they are {i}definitely{/i} not going to check on us. Sooooo...{i}yeah.{/i}
lines.zh: 我对你的信心刚刚好。而且我们来的是夜里只有一个员工在班的时段，而那个人{i}绝对{/i}不会来查我们。所~~~~以……{i}对呀{/i}。

lines.en: : Calm down, please. I don’t need another Sana.
lines.zh: : 拜托冷静点。我不需要再一个 Sana。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I’m sure I’ll go right back to being nervous and scared the second we sit down.
lines.zh: : 对不起。我敢保证等我们一坐下，我就会立刻变回紧张害怕的样子。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss18
(She did.)
lines.zh: （她确实变回去了。）

lines.en: : So...what do you...want to sing?...
lines.zh: : 那么……你想……唱什么？……

lines.en: : Uta. Look at me.
lines.zh: : Uta。看着我。

lines.en: : I don’t think I can.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我做不到。

lines.en: : I think you should try.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你该试试。

lines.en: : H...How about I just close my eyes and you take all of my clothes off and touch me all over the place and don’t expect me to say a single word until you’re done and I’m done and we’re both done?
lines.zh: 那……不如我就闭上眼睛，你把我的衣服全脱掉，把我浑身上下都摸遍，而且别指望我说一个字，直到你完事了、我完事了、我们两个都完事了？

lines.en: : Is that the line that won over all those old guys?
lines.zh: : 就是这句台词把所有那些老男人拿下的？

lines.en: : No. My answer to “asl?” got that done pretty quickly.
lines.zh: : 不是。是我对“asl？”的回答，那才快得很。

lines.en: : We don’t {i}need{/i} to do this, you know. Like, I get that we both {i}want{/i} it. But you’re clearly scared and...to be honest, I don’t exactly have the best track record with this place.
lines.zh: : 我们不{i}一定{/i}要做这个，你知道的。我是说，我知道我们两个都{i}想{/i}。可你明显在害怕，而且……说实话，我对这地方的履历可不怎么好看。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss19
: What do you mean by-
lines.zh: : 你是什么意思——

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss20
: Uh...what do you mean by that?...
lines.zh: : 呃……你是什么意思？……

lines.en: : Just bad memories for the most part.
lines.zh: : 大部分只是些糟糕的回忆罢了。

lines.en: : Is it because of Despacito? I’ve come here with Ayane before. I know her game.
lines.zh: : 是因为《Despacito》吗？我以前和 Ayane 来过。我知道她的套路。

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, Despacito is one of my {i}best{/i} memories of this place.
lines.zh: : 说来也怪，《Despacito》是我对这地方{i}最好{/i}的回忆之一。

lines.en: : Well...I...
scene utakaraokekiss21
: I don’t know what’s gone on in the past, but...one of my favorite memories with you happened right in this very room.
lines.zh: : 我不知道过去发生过什么，可是……我最喜欢的一段和你的回忆，就发生在这间屋子里。

lines.en: : It’s when you fell on top of me, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是你摔在我身上那次，对吧？

lines.en: : That’s the closest we’ve ever come to having sex.
lines.zh: : 那是我们最接近做爱的一次。

lines.en: : I’ve been naked in front of you on several occasions now.
lines.zh: : 我已经在你面前赤身裸体过好几次了。

lines.en: : And not a single one of them was as sexually charged as that collision.
lines.zh: : 可没有哪一次比那次碰撞更有性张力。

lines.en: : Regardless, I don’t know what made you start disliking this place and...I wouldn’t have brought you here if I knew. But Io’s in the dorm right now and...
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我不知道你是因为什么开始讨厌这儿的……要是我知道就不会带你来了。可 Io 现在在宿舍，而且……

lines.en: : Well, I...it’s...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……只是……

lines.en: : It’s not too late to start making {i}good{/i} memories, is it? Just...overwriting all the bad ones and...I...
lines.zh: : 现在开始制造{i}好{/i}回忆还不算太晚，对吧？只要……把所有糟糕的都覆盖掉，然后……我……

lines.en: : I really like you, Sensei...like...a lot, a lot, a lot, a lot. A lot. And this whole thing with Niki? It’s, like...I’m in panic mode now and I know I need to act or I’ll get left behind and-
lines.zh: 我真的很喜欢你，Sensei……喜欢得……非常、非常、非常、非常。非常。而 Niki 这整件事？就是……我现在进入恐慌模式了，我知道我得行动，不然就会被落下，然后——

lines.en: : Getting left behind is the last thing you need to worry about, Uta.
lines.zh: : 被落下是你最不需要担心的事，Uta。

lines.en: : It’s {i}not,{/i} though. You probably say that to {i}everybody{/i} and, just as a reminder, I want to {i}win.{/i}
lines.zh: : 才{i}不是{/i}呢。这话你大概对{i}每个人{/i}都说过，而且提醒你一下，我想要{i}赢{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t want to share you with anybody at the end of the day. And can I really {i}win{/i} the way I am now, Sensei? No. Not a chance.
lines.zh: 说到底我不想和任何人分享你。就以我现在这个样子，我真的能{i}赢{/i}吗，Sensei？不能。一点机会都没有。

lines.en: : I’m up against your childhood friend. I’m up against whatever Maya is. And I’m up against {i}Ayane,{/i} who is basically your wife already. So I really {i}might{/i} get left behind at this rate.
lines.zh: 我的对手是你的青梅竹马。是那个不知道算什么的 Maya。还有{i}Ayane{/i}，她基本上已经是你老婆了。所以照这个速度，我真的{i}可能{/i}会被落下。

lines.en: : Not to break your stride or anything, but weren’t you going to start calling me Akira?
lines.zh: : 不是要打断你的节奏，不过你不是要开始叫我 Akira 了吗？

lines.en: : Not to break {i}your{/i} stride or anything, but weren’t you going to take all of my clothes off and touch me all over the place?
lines.zh: : 也不是要打断{i}你的{/i}节奏，不过你不是要把我的衣服全脱掉、把我浑身上下都摸一遍吗？

lines.en: : You know that microphone’s been on this whole time, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道麦克风一直都开着吧？

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss22
: Oh, so {i}that’s{/i} why my voice was so loud. I thought it was just nerves again.
lines.zh: : 哦，原来我的声音那么大是{i}这么回事{/i}。我还以为又只是紧张。

lines.en: scene utakaraokekiss23

: Uta, I am more than happy to {i}continue{/i} if you’re really sure about this. I can’t guarantee it will “overwrite” the bad memories I have here or anything, but I’m trying not to think of that right now.
lines.zh: Uta，如果你真的确定，我非常乐意{i}继续{/i}。我不能保证它能“覆盖”我在这里的糟糕回忆什么的，不过我现在正努力不去想那个。

lines.en: : I have to warn you about something, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我得先警告你一件事。

lines.en: : I know first times hurt. It’s okay.
lines.zh: : 我知道第一次会疼。没关系。

lines.en: : Not that. I need to warn you that there is a small chance I may lose control in the middle of whatever we wind up doing and that it could potentially put you in a compromising and dangerous position.
lines.zh: 不是那个。我要警告你的是，在我们最终要做的那件事进行到中途时，有很小的概率我会失控，而这有可能把你置于一个尴尬且危险的境地。

lines.en: : You mean like the backwards spider crawl?
lines.zh: : 你是说像倒着蜘蛛爬那样？

lines.en: : I mean like losing grip on who I am and where I am and acting purely on rabid instinct.
lines.zh: : 我是说像失去对自己是谁、身在何处的把握，纯粹凭着狂躁的本能行事。
